answer: The kernel assignment is published and horizon records each panel. Shards are assigned from the mesa graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1611 impostors cost 678 times the honest price and take 11 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
